map.薄壁孔口自由出流流量。: Free discharge through a thin-wall orifice.
map.Q = C_d A√(2ΔP/ρ)。 重力出流时 ΔP=ρgh。: Q = C_d A√(2ΔP/ρ). For gravity driven discharge ΔP=ρgh.
map.算小孔出流: Compute the discharge through a small orifice
map.Q = Cd*A*sqrt(2*g*h)。例：A=1 cm2、h=2 m、Cd=: Q = Cd*A*sqrt(2*g*h). Example: with A=1 cm², h=2 m and Cd=0.62, Q=0.62*1e-4*sqrt(39.24)=3.88e-4 m³/s=0.388 L/s.
map.流量系数，薄壁小孔约 0.61-0.62。: The discharge coefficient of a small thin-wall orifice is about 0.61-0.62.
map.射流收缩 Ae<C*A，Cd=Cc*Cv。: The jet contracts so that Ae is smaller than C*A, with Cd = Cc*Cv.
map.孔口出流流量：Q = C_d·A·√(2ΔP ÷ ρ)（m³/s，C_d 流量系: Orifice discharge: Q = C_d·A·√(2ΔP ÷ ρ) (m³/s, C_d discharge coefficient, A orifice area in m², ΔP pressure difference in Pa, ρ density in kg/m³). Validation: C_d, A, ΔP and ρ are all required, and ρ as a denominator must not be 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; flow is proportional to the square root of the pressure difference; gravity discharge (ΔP=ρgh) must first be converted to an equivalent pressure difference, and the page does not implement that branch separately.
